blocks.raw: # Understand Audience Reachability Status
blocks.text: Understand Audience Reachability Status

blocks.raw: Reachability refers to whether a user can be contacted via a specific communication channel. It helps determine if a particular user can receive messages or notifications sent through that channel.
blocks.text: Reachability refers to whether a user can be contacted via a specific communication channel. It helps determine if a particular user can receive messages or notifications sent through that channel.

blocks.raw: You can view the reachability status in the audience view detail page.
blocks.text: You can view the reachability status in the audience view detail page.

blocks.raw: Example: A user has created a campaign and wants to understand via which communication channel the reachability is more. They can view the reachability under the specific audience group.
blocks.text: Example: A user has created a campaign and wants to understand via which communication channel the reachability is more. They can view the reachability under the specific audience group.

blocks.raw: # Reachability Categories
blocks.text: Reachability Categories

blocks.raw:
| **Category**             | **Reachability Status** | **Description**                                          |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| **VALID**                | ✅                       | The user is reachable and valid.                         |
| **SUBSCRIBED**           | 🟢                      | The user is reachable and has subscribed.                |
| **UNABLE\_TO\_VERIFY**   | ❓                       | Unable to verify the user’s reachability.                |
| **SOFT\_BOUNCED**        | 🔄                      | There were soft bounces. More may lead to HARD\_BOUNCED. |
| **CONTACT\_UNAVAILABLE** | 🚫                      | The user’s registered contact is not available.          |
| **UNSUBSCRIBED**         | 🔕                      | The user has unsubscribed from communications.           |
| **INVALID**              | ❌                       | The user’s registered contact is invalid.                |
| **HARD\_BOUNCED**        | 🛑                      | Previous communications have HARD\_BOUNCED.              |

blocks.raw: # When is Reachability Calculated?
blocks.text: When is Reachability Calculated?

blocks.raw:
* **Immediate and Specific Date Messages:** Reachability is computed before campaign creation.
* **Recurring Campaigns:** Reachability for the filter list is calculated at the pre-execution stage.
blocks.text: Immediate and Specific Date Messages: Reachability is computed before campaign creation.Recurring Campaigns: Reachability for the filter list is calculated at the pre-execution stage.

blocks.raw: # Reachability computation
blocks.text: Reachability computation

blocks.raw: Audience reachability is calculated separately for each communication channel (SMS, WhatsApp, Viber, RCS, Email, Push, etc.) based on the user’s whitelisted contact details and subscription status.
blocks.text: Audience reachability is calculated separately for each communication channel (SMS, WhatsApp, Viber, RCS, Email, Push, etc.) based on the user’s whitelisted contact details and subscription status.

blocks.raw: Push notifications are delivered only to customers who have a valid push registration token for the targeted platform (for example, iOS or Android). If a customer does not have a registered token for the selected platform, the notification is not delivered even if the customer qualifies for the campaign.
blocks.text: Push notifications are delivered only to customers who have a valid push registration token for the targeted platform (for example, iOS or Android). If a customer does not have a registered token for the selected platform, the notification is not delivered even if the customer qualifies for the campaign.

blocks.raw: If a customer is not reachable on the primary channel, the system automatically attempts to send the message through the fallback channel (if available). If a user’s subscription status is unknown, they are considered reachable.
blocks.text: If a customer is not reachable on the primary channel, the system automatically attempts to send the message through the fallback channel (if available). If a user’s subscription status is unknown, they are considered reachable.

blocks.raw:
> 📘 Note
>
> * If a customer has experienced a hard bounce even once, or three soft bounces in previous communication attempts, the system automatically blocks future messages to that customer to prevent repeated delivery failures.
> * Users whose email addresses have a hard bounce status are excluded from coupon issuance and message delivery, even if they meet all eligibility and filter criteria. Hard bounce status overrides filter qualification. These users will not receive campaign incentives or communications.

blocks.raw: ## WhatsApp and Viber fallback mechanism
blocks.text: WhatsApp and Viber fallback mechanism

blocks.raw: To maximise campaign delivery rates, Engage+ features an automatic fallback system. When a customer in your audience has opted in for WhatsApp or Viber communications, but their primary profile lacks a valid WhatsApp or Viber number, the system automatically searches for an alternative mobile number from other available sources before failing the message.
blocks.text: To maximise campaign delivery rates, Engage+ features an automatic fallback system. When a customer in your audience has opted in for WhatsApp or Viber communications, but their primary profile lacks a valid WhatsApp or Viber number, the system automatically searches for an alternative mobile number from other available sources before failing the message.

blocks.raw: The following flow is followed when a WhatsApp or Viber campaign is scheduled:
blocks.text: The following flow is followed when a WhatsApp or Viber campaign is scheduled:

blocks.raw: **Primary WhatsApp or Viber Number (V2 Profile)**: First, the system checks for a registered WhatsApp or Viber number in the customer's primary [V2 profile](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/customer-profiles#/v2-profile-identifier-addupdate).
blocks.text: Primary WhatsApp or Viber Number (V2 Profile): First, the system checks for a registered WhatsApp or Viber number in the customer's primary V2 profile.

blocks.raw: **Linked SMS Number (V2 Profile)**: If no WhatsApp or Viber number is found, the system looks for a mobile number within the customer's [InStore profile](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/customer-overview#/source-profiles).
blocks.text: Linked SMS Number (V2 Profile): If no WhatsApp or Viber number is found, the system looks for a mobile number within the customer's InStore profile.

blocks.raw: **Uploaded Audience List**: As a final step, if no number has been found in any of the system profiles, the system checks the audience list you uploaded for the specific campaign for a mobile number associated with that customer.
blocks.text: Uploaded Audience List: As a final step, if no number has been found in any of the system profiles, the system checks the audience list you uploaded for the specific campaign for a mobile number associated with that customer.

blocks.raw: If no mobile number can be found after checking all these sources, the message delivery will fail for that user, and they will be excluded from the campaign audience.
blocks.text: If no mobile number can be found after checking all these sources, the message delivery will fail for that user, and they will be excluded from the campaign audience.
